item.subject: science
item.stem: Ravi measures his body temperature with a clinical thermometer at home in Chennai. The reading is 37.3 °C. His grandmother says he must be ill because his temperature is not exactly 37.0 °C. What is the correct conclusion?

options.A: Ravi is definitely ill, because every healthy person has a temperature of exactly 37.0 °C.
options.B: Ravi's temperature can still be normal, because 37.0 °C is an average and healthy people may read slightly above or below it.
options.C: The thermometer must be broken, because no healthy person can have a temperature above 37.0 °C.
options.D: Ravi must measure again at noon, because body temperature is only normal in the afternoon.
